title: Oglas za posao — Tehno-control d.o.o. Podgorica
excerpt:
Ovlašćena organizacija za poslove zaštite i zdravlja na radu, sa sektorima u Podgorici i Nikšiću, zbog povećanog obima posla zapošljava na neodređeno vrijeme.

Otvorene pozicije: mašinski inženjer/ka, građevinski inženjer/ka.

Uslovi: položen stručni ispit iz zaštite i zdravlja na radu, najmanje 3 godine radnog iskustva, vozačka dozvola B kategorije, poznavanje rada na računaru.

Kako da se prijavite / kontakt: e-mail info@uznr.me i tehno-control@t-com.me, tel. 069/484-031, 069/068-312.

Napomena: Zainteresovani kandidati mogu poslati prijavu i kratku biografiju, a biće kontaktirani kandidati koji uđu u uži izbor.
excerpt_en:
A licensed occupational safety and health organisation with departments in Podgorica and Nikšić is hiring on a permanent basis due to an increased workload.

Open positions: mechanical engineer, civil engineer.

Requirements: passed professional examination in occupational safety and health, at least 3 years of work experience, category B driving licence, computer literacy.

How to apply / contact: e-mail info@uznr.me and tehno-control@t-com.me, tel. 069/484-031, 069/068-312.

Note: Interested candidates may send an application together with a short CV; shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je otvorilo pozicije za sedam korisnika/ca Programa stručnog osposobljavanja lica sa stečenim visokim obrazovanjem
excerpt:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je otvorilo pozicije za sedam korisnika/ca Programa stručnog osposobljavanja lica sa stečenim visokim obrazovanjem:

Zaštita na radu (2), Odnosi sa javnošću (1), Poslovni engleski jezik (1), Engleski jezik i književnost (1), Pravo (1), Marketing (1).

Pozivamo te da se pridružiš našem timu, a o aktivnostima koje realizujemo se možeš informisati putem naših društvenih mreža. Za sve dodatne informacije, budi slobodan/a da nas kontaktiraš putem mejla/nekog od navedenih brojeva telefona. Adresa Udruženja: Ulica 4. jula 109/3, zgrada Zetagradnje na Zabjelu. Radujemo se budućem druženju! Dobro došli!

Prijave se mogu izvršiti do 10.12.2022. godine, na sajtu eUprave.
title_en: The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro has opened seven positions under the Professional Training Programme for graduates
excerpt_en:
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro has opened seven positions under the Professional Training Programme for people with a completed higher education:

Occupational safety (2), Public relations (1), Business English (1), English language and literature (1), Law (1), Marketing (1).

We invite you to join our team — you can follow the activities we run through our social media channels. For any further information, feel free to contact us by e-mail or on one of the phone numbers listed. The Association's address: Ulica 4. jula 109/3, the Zetagradnja building in Zabjelo. We look forward to meeting you. Welcome!

Applications are open until 10 December 2022, through the eUprava portal.

title: Poziv za angažovanje predavača u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“
excerpt:
UZNR CG poziva eksperte iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu (članove Udruženja) za predavanja na edukativnim radionicama i obukama, koje će biti realizovane tokom oktobra i novembra 2022. godine, u srednjim stručnim školama u Podgorici, Bijelom Polju i Nikšiću, kao i na tehničkim i tehničko-tehnološkim fakultetima u Podgorici. Kroz obuke, koje će biti prilagođene ciljnim grupama, mladi ljudi će biti upoznati sa izazovima i problemima u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, s kojima će se suočiti dolaskom na tržište rada, nakon završenog procesa obrazovanja.

Ova aktivnost će biti sprovedena u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“ koji je finansiran od strane Evropske komisije i Ministarstva javne uprave, a koji se realizuje u saradnji i uz podršku NVO Prima i YouthHUB mreže Zapadnog Balkana i Turske.

Poziv je otvoren do 16. jula 2022.
title_en: Call for lecturers under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”
excerpt_en:
UZNR CG invites experts in occupational safety and health (members of the Association) to lecture at educational workshops and training sessions to be held during October and November 2022, in secondary vocational schools in Podgorica, Bijelo Polje and Nikšić, as well as at the technical and technological faculties in Podgorica. Through the training, which will be tailored to its target groups, young people will learn about the challenges and problems in occupational safety and health that they will face when they enter the labour market after finishing their education.

This activity will be carried out under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, financed by the European Commission and the Ministry of Public Administration, and implemented in cooperation with and with the support of the NGO Prima and the YouthHUB network of the Western Balkans and Türkiye.

The call is open until 16 July 2022.

title: Regionalni poziv za dodjelu grant sredstava za lokalne NVO
excerpt:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore u partnerstvu sa Makedonskom udruženjem za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu (MOSHA), Eko centrom Srbija, Kosovskim udruženjem za bezbjednost i zdravlje na radu (KOSHA) i Albanskim udruženjem za bezbjednost i zdravlje na radu (AOSHC), u okviru projekta „Poboljšanje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“ (broj ugovora IPA/2019/413-810), uz podršku Evropske komisije, objavljuje regionalni poziv za šemu subgrantiranja lokalnih NVO za projekte u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu. Rok za prijavu s punom aplikacijom je 23.02.2022. u 16:00 h.

Info sesija vezana za dodjelu bespovratnih sredstava održaće se 18. januara, u 11 h putem ZOOM platforme.

Zainteresovani treba da prijave svoje učešće na sljedeći e-mail: kontakt@mzzpr.org.mk. Svi detalji poziva kao i prijavna dokumentacija nalaze se u prilozima.
title_en: Regional call for grants for local NGOs
excerpt_en:
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, in partnership with the Macedonian Occupational Safety and Health Association (MOSHA), Eko centar Serbia, the Kosovo Occupational Safety and Health Association (KOSHA) and the Albanian Occupational Safety and Health Association (AOSHC), under the project “Improving working conditions and occupational safety and health in support of the Western Balkan countries in the EU accession process” (contract number IPA/2019/413-810) and with the support of the European Commission, is publishing a regional call for a sub-granting scheme for local NGOs for projects in the field of occupational safety and health. The deadline for applications with the full application form is 23 February 2022 at 16:00.

An info session on the award of the grants will be held on 18 January at 11:00 via the ZOOM platform.

Those interested should register their participation at the following e-mail address: kontakt@mzzpr.org.mk. All details of the call and the application documents are in the attachments.

title: Poziv u okviru projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“

Vodič će inspektorima služiti kao smjernica koja će omogućiti sprovođenje proaktivnih posjeta gradilištima, u okviru projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“ koji je finansiran od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja.
title_en: Call under the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”
excerpt_en: A call for an occupational safety and health expert to produce a Guide for labour inspectors in the field of occupational safety and health. The guide will serve inspectors as guidance enabling proactive visits to construction sites, under the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development.
